items.title: Bangkok fire investigation finds locked doors and flammable decor as deaths climb to 30
items.description: Survivors and first responders reported locked doors and a lack of signage marking emergency exits.

items.title: Australian police reveal unseen photos 25 years after British backpacker murder
items.description: Police hope the images could jog memories that will help them find the body of Peter Falconio.

items.title: Hungary parliament votes to remove president from office
items.description: Tamás Sulyok was widely seen as a loyalist of former prime minister Viktor Orbán, who lost power in April after 16 years.

items.title: US judge voids Donald Trump's $1.8bn settlement with IRS that gave him immunity from tax audits
items.description: The judge said the suit was brought for 'improper purposes' and referred a Trump attorney for possible disciplinary action.

items.title: Colombian national killed by ICE agent during operation in Maine
items.description: It comes less than a week after an undocumented migrant was fatally shot in Houston by an immigration agent.

items.title: Identity of Sydney daycare worker facing 329 child abuse offences revealed
items.description: Hamish Tait is accused of abusing 136 children at five childcare facilities over a 16-year period.

items.title: Bison rams grandfather in Yellowstone Park, knocking him metres into the air
items.description: The man and his grandson appeared a safe distance away from the bison before it quickly chased them down.

items.title: Health fears as frail Indian activist on hunger strike loses 8.2kg
items.description: The environmental activist has been on a hunger strike for 16 days and is getting visibly weaker.

items.title: US burrito giant Chipotle opening first outlet in Mexico
items.description: Other US fast food brands have struggled to succeed in the countries their dishes originated.

items.title: Briton tells of surviving Spain wildfire in car as wife and friends died trying to run to safety
items.description: Malcolm Timbrell's wife and their friends are thought to have died when a devastating wildfire tore through their village in Spain.

items.title: 'Hero, legend, sweetheart': Tributes to Jurassic Park actor Sam Neill, who has died aged 78
items.description: Friends, politicians and fellow film stars remember Neill following his "sudden and unexpected" death.

items.title: Lindsey Graham's sister chosen as replacement after senator's death
items.description: The South Carolina governor chose the senator's little sister to serve out the rest of his term after Graham's death on Saturday.
